Population increased in Essex

The estimated population of Essex in 2024 was 1,563,365 usual residents, a rise of 1.4% since 2023.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Essex increased by 3.8%.

Age profile of Essex

The average (median) age fell to 42.3 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Essex has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.subtitle: Population age structure by single year of age and sex for Essex, 2011 to 2024
sections.source: Office for National Statistics – Mid-year population estimates

sections.content:
By age category, Essex's population of 1,563,365 usual residents was made up of:

  • 292,209 people aged 0 to 15 years, (18.7%)
  • 945,295 people aged 16 to 64 years, (60.5%)
  • 325,861 people aged 65 years and over, (20.8%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Essex has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 16 to 64 years (60.5% compared with 62.8% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Essex, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Essex
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Essex, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 511 people (0%). In total, there were 15,283 births and 14,772 deaths in Essex.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 7,538 (0.5%). There were 65,989 people entering the area and 58,451 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Essex's population of 12,913 (0.8%) as a result of 17,991 people entering the area and 5,078 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Essex was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Essex in mid-2023 is 1,542,488.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 5,767 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 603 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 6,370 people.
